label: USAF Risk Assessment Matrix
description: US Air Force / MIL-STD-882 Risk Assessment Matrix — hazard Severity x Probability -> risk level (Extremely High / High / Medium / Low).

metrics.label: Severity (effect of hazard)
metrics.description: Worst credible outcome of the hazard.

options.label: I — Catastrophic
options.description: Death, loss of asset, mission capability or unit readiness

options.label: II — Critical
options.description: Severe injury or damage, significantly degraded mission capability or unit readiness

options.label: III — Moderate
options.description: Minor injury or damage, degraded mission capability or unit readiness

options.label: IV — Negligible
options.description: Minimal injury or damage, little or no mission capability or unit readiness

metrics.label: Probability (frequency of occurrence)
metrics.description: How often the hazard is expected to occur over time.

options.label: D — Seldom
options.description: Unlikely; can be expected to occur
